# DYMO Connect Framework

Vendored from the official `dymosoftware/dymo-connect-framework` repository at commit
`2182e505e334663bf79a48dea24800f2aebcfa98`.

The framework is loaded only for authenticated users configured as an enabled RELAY label
print station. Its local web API requires DYMO Connect to be installed and running on the
same computer as the browser and USB printer.

See `LICENSE.txt` for the upstream MIT licence.
